Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Chart, s As String, block As Range
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "j"
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "k"
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "l"
        ws.Cells(1, 4).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "p"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = "a"

        ws.Cells(3, 4).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(4, 1).Value = "q"
        ws.Cells(4, 2).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(4, 3).Value = "c"
        ws.Cells(4, 4).Value = 3
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(4, 4))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 1
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "k"
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "l"
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "m"
        ws.Cells(1, 4).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 5
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = "a"
        ws.Cells(2, 4).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 6
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = "b"
        ws.Cells(3, 4).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(4, 1).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(4, 2).Value = 7
        ws.Cells(4, 3).Value = "c"
        ws.Cells(4, 4).Value = 3
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(4, 4))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 2
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "j"
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "k"
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "l"
        ws.Cells(1, 4).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(1, 5).Value = "u"
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "p"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = "a"
        ws.Cells(2, 4).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(2, 5).Value = 4
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "p"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = "b"
        ws.Cells(3, 4).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(3, 5).Value = 5
        ws.Cells(4, 1).Value = "q"
        ws.Cells(4, 2).Value = "z"
        ws.Cells(4, 3).Value = "c"
        ws.Cells(4, 4).Value = 3
        ws.Cells(4, 5).Value = 6
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(4, 5))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 3
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "k"
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "u"
        ws.Cells(1, 4).Value = "t"
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(2, 4).Value = 3
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 4
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 5
        ws.Cells(3, 4).Value = 6
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(3, 4))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 4
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 5
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 6
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 2
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(3, 3))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 5
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = "a"
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = "b"
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 2
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(3, 3))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 6
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = "a"
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = "b"
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 2
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(3, 3))
        block.Select
    Case 7
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = 3
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 4
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(3, 2))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 8
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "u"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 4
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 5
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(3, 3))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 9
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "u"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 4
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 5
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(3, 3))
        block.Select
    Case 10
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = "w"
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = "a"
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(4, 1).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(4, 2).Value = "b"
        ws.Cells(4, 3).Value = 2
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(4, 3))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 11
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = "w"
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = "a"
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(4, 1).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(4, 2).Value = "b"
        ws.Cells(4, 3).Value = 2
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(4, 3))
        block.Select
    Case 12
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = 3
        ws.Cells(1, 4).Value = 4
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = 5
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 6
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 7
        ws.Cells(2, 4).Value = 8
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(2, 4))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 13
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = 3
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 4
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = 5
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 6
        ws.Cells(4, 1).Value = 7
        ws.Cells(4, 2).Value = 8
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(4, 2))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 14
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = 3
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 4
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(2, 2))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    Case 15
        ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = "k"
        ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "v"
        ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "u"
        ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "x"
        ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 1
        ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 2
        ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "y"
        ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 3
        ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 4
        Set block = ws.Range("A1", ws.Cells(3, 3))
        ws.Range("A1").Select
    End Select
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(200, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ch.SetSourceData block
    s = ch.SeriesCollection.Count & "|" & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Formula
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 15
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
